title: fix(plugin-auth): a refused enterprise OIDC sign-in names its cause
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiXg46wP2iyXrx3QP2KhstCt)_

Fixes #30965

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：企业 OIDC 单点登录被拒时，跳转里的 `error_description` 从一律的 `token_not_verified` 改成具体原因（过期、未生效、受众不对、签发方不对、签名密钥未知、签名无效），服务器同时写一行 warn 日志（providerId、协议、原因）。
- 为什么改：Okta / Entra ID 接入时任何配置错误都显示同一句，管理员无法自查（cloud#3666 实测）。按裁定 D + A + V1 只做 OIDC，SAML 等上游。
- 风险与回滚：better-auth 自己的日志改走 AuthManager 的 logger（级别不变），没配 logger 时仍走控制台；`error=` 不变。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`sso-oidc-refusal-cause.ts`（分类与改写，风险在 `runSsoOidcCallbackScope`）、`auth-manager-request-routing.ts`（作用域挂载点）、`sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts`（端到端用例）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts`，预期 15 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12 answers every refused ID token on the OIDC callback with one redirect, `error=invalid_provider&error_description=token_not_verified`. The `jose` error that names the cause reaches only the vendor's logger (`ctx.context.logger.error(error)` in `handleOIDCCallback`). Per the ruling (D + A + V1, comment 6709033929), this PR reads it there and does OIDC only:

- **`sso-oidc-refusal-cause.ts`** (new). `createBetterAuthLogSink` is the `logger` plugin-auth now hands `betterAuth`. `runSsoOidcCallbackScope` wraps one `/sso/callback/:providerId` request in an `AsyncLocalStorage` scope. Inside that scope the sink holds back an `error` line whose message is a `jose` error with a classified `code` (and `claim`), and records the cause. When the vendor answers the opaque redirect, the scope does three things: it replaces the `error_description` segment with the cause and leaves every other byte and header as they were, it writes one `warn` line (`providerId`, `protocol: 'oidc'`, `cause`), and it drops the held vendor line, which the warn line replaces. Any other answer releases the held lines unchanged.
- **Closed list**, exported as `SSO_OIDC_REFUSAL_CAUSES`: `id_token_expired` (`ERR_JWT_EXPIRED`), `id_token_not_yet_valid` (`ERR_JWT_CLAIM_VALIDATION_FAILED` + `nbf`), `id_token_audience_mismatch` (+ `aud`), `id_token_issuer_mismatch` (+ `iss`), `id_token_signing_key_unknown` (`ERR_JWKS_NO_MATCHING_KEY`), `id_token_signature_invalid` (`ERR_JWS_SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED`). Anything else keeps `token_not_verified` and still gets the warn line. Classification never reads message text.
- **Wiring**: `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts` passes the sink; `auth-manager-request-routing.ts` opens the scope for the per-provider callback path through a new `AuthManager.runSsoOidcCallback` host member. The shared `/sso/callback` endpoint is not scoped: it is reached only when `sso({ redirectURI })` is set, and plugin-auth does not set it.
- **How existing better-auth log lines move**: they now reach the `AuthManager` logger instead of the console, at the level better-auth chose (`error` stays `error`, `warn` stays `warn`; no regrading under the "Degradation log levels" rule, because the vendor already graded them). `info`/`debug` stay unpublished (the vendor's default level `warn` is unchanged). With no logger configured they go to the console as before. A message that is an error object is rendered as its name and message, as the vendor's console logger rendered it, so a `jose` claim error's `payload` (the token's claims) never reaches a line. Further arguments pass through unchanged. `driver-fault-auth-log-carriers.test.ts` now reads the library's carriers from both the console and the manager logger, and its assertions are otherwise unchanged.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` gains "Why an OIDC sign-in was refused", with one row per cause and what to check.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch. `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch` (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3). The new export is a runtime constant, not an authorable key.

Not here: SAML (the vendor discards that cause inside a bare `catch`, and it goes to a follow-up card upstream-first), `packages/spec`, ADR-0112. The values are lowercase `error_description` tokens in the vendor's dialect for that slot, not ledger codes (ruling V1).

## Tests

`sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts` drives a real `AuthManager` with the real `sso()` plugin through `/sign-in/sso` → `/sso/callback/:providerId`. Only the IdP's token and JWKS endpoints are stubbed. The ID tokens are signed in the test with generated RS256 keys, so every refusal comes from the vendor's real verifier.

- CONTROL: a valid token signs in (302 to `callbackURL`, session cookie, no refusal line).
- One case per cause: the redirect carries `error=invalid_provider` and the cause, there is exactly one warn line `{ providerId, protocol: 'oidc', cause }`, and no vendor `error` line.
- Unclassified (`azp` naming another client): keeps `token_not_verified`, writes the warn line, and the vendor's diagnosis still reaches the log.
- No-leak: neither the Location nor any logger channel carries the token, its payload segment, the subject, the email or the name. A known account and an unknown one get identical redirects and lines.
- Unit: classification by code and claim only, the path scope, a byte-exact rewrite with headers kept, held lines released on other answers, and forwarding outside a scope.

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

Run on the 16-case file before the docs-table pin was dropped (heads b73a45f0 for 1 and 2, 07fe9fcb for 3); the per-cause and no-leak cases are unchanged since.

1. Side channel off (`const cause = undefined` in the sink): 7 failed / 9 passed (all six per-cause E2E cases and the rewrite unit case).
2. Sink not handed to `betterAuth` (the `logger:` line deleted): 7 failed / 9 passed (six per-cause cases plus the unclassified case). This is the shape a vendor bump that stops passing the error object would take.
3. Error-message rendering leaks the error's own properties (`JSON.stringify({ ...message })`): 2 failed / 14 passed, including the held-line no-leak pin.

A first version that also reshaped the vendor's further arguments was measured against `driver-fault-auth-log-carriers.test.ts` (the error object's `cause` stopped surviving). The arguments now pass through as written.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs (final head b0a55dc3)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` at 07fe9fcb (after merging origin/main): Test Files 235 passed (235), Tests 4184 passed, 10 skipped. Since then only a comment move in `auth-manager-request-routing.ts` and the removal of one test case; the new file reruns 15/15 at b0a55dc3.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0 (includes `check:test-typecheck`, debt unchanged).
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: exit 0.
- Derived gates at b0a55dc3 (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 95 derived, 95 run, every one `:: exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: 95 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Three gates first answered exit 3 for missing prerequisites (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on a shallow clone, `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` without a full build); fixed by fetching the fixture commit and a full `pnpm build` (119/119), then rerun green.
- A first gate pass flagged `check:cross-package-test-inputs`: a docs-table pin read `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` from the plugin-auth test. That pin was dropped rather than widening the package's declared inputs.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The cloud#3666 `it.todo` cases for OIDC (wrong audience, expired token, foreign issuer, retired key) can go live against this behaviour; the cloud repo is not edited here. The SAML todos stay todo until the follow-up card lands.
- The mechanism depends on the vendor handing its logger the `jose` error object. Ablation 2 shows the per-cause tests go red if that stops, so a bump cannot silently fall back.
- The docs table and `SSO_OIDC_REFUSAL_CAUSES` are kept equal by hand: a pin would read outside the package, which `check:cross-package-test-inputs` requires declaring in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json`, outside this card's file surface.
